repairs.quote: Every (25 ~ 16) seconds Vex becomes afflicted with Doom, causing her next basic Ability to Knock Down and Fear enemies for (0.75 ~ 1.5) seconds.
Vex's next Attack against a Gloomed enemy deals an additional ((40 ~ 150) + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage and reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 25%.
